ChangeList.Description: Added support for the application permission `Calendars.Read.All` to the following operations of the [workHoursAndLocationsSetting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/workhoursandlocationssetting?view=graph-rest-beta) resource: [GET](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/workhoursandlocationssetting-get?view=graph-rest-beta) and [occurrencesView](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/workhoursandlocationssetting-occurrencesview?view=graph-rest-beta).
